_doc: Template for the 2025 Cayman Islands General Election. Fill in the candidates and results arrays per constituency, then run `npm run import:2025`. The importer is idempotent - re-running updates existing rows by (electionCycle + constituency + shorthandCode). Source: portal.elections.ky/index.php/candidates-agents/2025-candidates plus the official Declaration of Results PDF (or news outlets until the PDF is published).

cycle.name: 2025 General Election
cycle.notes: Election held 30 April 2025. 80 candidates across 19 constituencies.

constituencies._doc: Replace the placeholder list above with the actual nominated candidates for Red Bay. Repeat the pattern for the other 18 constituencies. Set `partyCode` to null for independents. Set `votes` once the Declaration is published; leave null for not-yet-known.
